svg.text: Step size: with the default 15° stride angle the foot swings ±7.5° around its hip, about 46 mm per step. Step height: 20 mm.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Starting and stopping: the step grows smoothly from zero over the first cycle and shrinks back over the last, so the robot never jerks.
